title: Lock source contract and frame inventory
description: Map source-of-truth, frames, icon manifest, and QA method into decisions and tests before code changes.
objective: Prevent the old frame plan from expanding into unrelated implementation work.
expected_outputs: decision records for shell, icons, runtime boundary, preview boundary, and frame classification
acceptance_criteria: Primary implementation frames are separated from secondary frames.
Reference-only and interaction-reference frames are not implemented as screens.
Canonical icon vocabulary is the only first-slice asset source.
Frame-driven QA is linked to implementation tasks.
verification: confirmed 28 frame files and 58 canonical icon paths exist

budgets.context_budget: source docs, frames README, icon manifest
budgets.validation_budget: human validation if frame source conflicts with source-of-truth

risks: Frame details can be hallucinated or inconsistent.
Icon names in the old plan exceed the canonical manifest.
